title: Laser-driven p-¹¹B aneutronic fusion via 8-spot ring magnetic reconnection — simulation and analysis suite
description: Computational research code for a tabletop-scale (≈5 J, 85 T) laser-driven p-¹¹B aneutronic fusion configuration based on 8-spot ring-geometry magnetic reconnection. Includes the WarpX/AMReX hybrid-PIC simulation driver, multi-tier orchestration pipeline (UUF factorial decomposition, rod-density linearity check, 512² grid-convergence partners), spatially-resolved first-transit fusion accounting analysis, per-zone diagnostics, and figure-generation scripts. The configuration produces 8 anti-parallel reconnection X-lines whose outflows converge on the ring centre, driving non-thermal proton acceleration above the p-¹¹B fusion threshold without bulk thermal heating.
notes: Initial public release. Paper 3 v0.8 Option G geometry: outer annulus at 3.7 mm (centre) gives a 600 µm clean buffer past the spot 2σ tail. Paper 1 anchors (ring radius 2.4 mm, spot σ 300 µm) preserved.
